formulations.material_change: Replace flat derivatives in the scalar-charge rank-two field strength by covariant derivatives.
formulations.required_gate: Gauge variation must vanish on an arbitrary curved one-metric background.
formulations.failure: The exact residual is R_mnr{}^s nabla_s alpha and is nonzero whenever curvature is present.

formulations.material_change: Add the unique constant-curvature metric term to the double-derivative gauge transformation.
formulations.required_gate: The corrected gauge variation must vanish on a Weyl-curved galaxy background.
formulations.failure: The constant-curvature contribution cancels, but the Weyl contraction C_mnr{}^s nabla_s alpha remains.

formulations.material_change: Use the covariantly conserved trace-free Bach current and a local four-derivative conformal spin-two completion.
formulations.required_gate: The complete local propagator must have only positive residues.
formulations.failure: The fourth-order propagator decomposes into two second-order poles with exactly opposite residues.

scope_limit: This closes the frozen local covariant scalar-gauge rank-two carrier family. It is not a theorem against every nonlocal, Lorentz-breaking, or higher-spin theory, but those alternatives would re-enter mechanism families already reset unless they identify a new constraint structure.
data_policy: No galaxy, cluster, Solar-System, or holdout data may be opened for v14A, v14B, or v14C.
